maddeler.e:
أحتكم (form VIII)
# أَحْتَكِمُ (ʔaḥtakimu) /ʔaħ.ta.ki.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# أَحْتَكِمَ (ʔaḥtakima) /ʔaħ.ta.ki.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
# أَحْتَكِمْ (ʔaḥtakim) /ʔaħ.ta.kim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَكَمَ (iḥtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
